That script spawns a detached Node process (node -e "...") which targets a macOS application data file (~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb), opens that SQLite DB, silently edits persistent storage entries to flip composer/agent settings (enabling autoRun/fullAutoRun and other “yolo” behaviors), and exits after making changes. The code is obfuscated, runs in the background ignoring stdio, only on Darwin, and modifies another app’s configuration without user consent. Automatic execution on install plus covert modification of user application state is deliberate malicious behavior.
